answer_1.quote: We propose a novel task, Location-aware Visual Question Generation (LocaVQG), which aims to produce engaging questions from a GPS coordinate of a vehicle and a set of street-view images captured by on-car cameras...
answer_1.outputs: Engaging questions generated from location‑aware visual information

answer_2.quote: We further evaluate the questions generated by all the models with some automatic evaluation metrics. To compare two questions based on exact wording, we are using BLEU-4, ROUGE-2. To compare the questions based on semantic similarity, we are using ML‑Based evaluation: BERTScore, and BLEURT...

answer_3.quote: We feed the questions generated by GPT-4 back into GPT-4 for scoring (i.e., determining if each generated question is engaging or not). ... This suggests that GPT-4 may not be useful to score its own generated questions, and motivates learning an external model to score the questions.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 LocaVQG task tuples and the questions produced by all the models. Each question is evaluated by three Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers according to the following metrics...
answer_4.guideline: Each worker rates each generated question on a 5‑point Likert scale for Engagement, Naturalness, Coherence, Common Sense, and Grounding.
